text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway after
training,
when...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So many things have happened over the
last three
years, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like such a long time,
but these
last few years have been the
most memorable
time of my life.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I never thought I'd be
able to make
a friend I could talk to like
this.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But with your help, I've been able to
learn so
much. Thank you, from the
bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing what's in store
for us in
the future,
Trainer
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As fellow trainers, let's continue to work
together
and give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Also, if it's all right with you... I was
thinking
about inviting both Meek and

<chrname> out...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You know... to have a party celebrating
all of our
hard work...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
How does karaoke sound? Maybe I'm being a
little too presumptuous, but I've
already done
some research on a
potential spot.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The food there looks great, and it's
really popular
with the younger crowd. I
think they'll both enjoy
it!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Great! They have this neat feature where
you can
order food via remote control,
so feel free to use
it whenever you like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We invite <chrname> and

Happy Meek, and we all have a great
time
singing and eating together.
